name: Jose Sosa
tagline: CS student at Rutgers, building AI products and full stack web apps.
about: I'm a Computer Science student at Rutgers University. I've interned at ADP, the State of New Jersey, and HuggleGroup, working across React/Next.js frontends, accessibility, CI/CD, and generative AI. Outside of internships I build my own projects, most recently an AI coaching app called Stackd.
